policy: Split strictly by source master so no fake derived from one master appears on both sides. All 11 ground-truth subcategories appear in both DEV and HOLDOUT. Thresholds/heuristics are developed on DEV only; HOLDOUT is evaluated once at the end of Phase B.

master_rationale.dev: ietf96 (24/96 Hi-Res), elec44 (16/44.1 loud electronic), studio48 (16/48 studio music) — 100 files covering all 11 subcategories including low-SR, Hi-Res upsample, and quiet/loud dynamic range.
master_rationale.holdout: piano96 (24/96 quiet acoustic solo piano), pink44 (16/44.1 broadband pink noise), mewkiz192 (16/192 ultra-Hi-Res + downsamples) — 79 files covering all 11 subcategories with strictly unseen acoustic/broadband/192k masters.
